cards.question: What access pattern does an RwLock allow?
cards.answer: One exclusive mutable reference, or multiple shared read references.

cards.question: How does an RwLock differ from a Mutex?
cards.answer: A Mutex only grants exclusive access even when a shared reference would suffice. An RwLock allows either one exclusive mutable reference or multiple shared read references.

cards.question: When is an RwLock optimal?
cards.answer: When the data is read frequently but written to infrequently.
